notes.title: Golfie v0.0.22 Hotfix 6
notes.notes:
[b]Golfie v0.0.22 Hotfix 6[/b] has been released!

[b]What's New:[/b]
- Fixed an issue where player with AMD GPUs could experience missing level geometry
- If the color behind the trajectory preview arrow is very similar to the arrow color, the hue is slightly shifted to increase visibility (most noticeable in Beach theme)
- Fixed various issues that could soft lock the game, or leave it in a buggy state

notes.title: Golfie v0.0.22 Hotfix 5
notes.notes:
[b]Golfie v0.0.22 Hotfix 5[/b] has been released!

[b]What's New:[/b]
- Increased scroll sensitivity in leadeboards
- Fixed a bunch of issues where card effects could carry over between runs (or even rounds)
- Only top 100 (+current player, if their score didn't make it to top 100) shows for leaderboards. In the future we'll add the ability to load more, or paginate in some way 🙂

notes.title: Golfie v0.0.22 Hotfix 4
notes.notes:
[b]Golfie v0.0.22 Hotfix 4 [/b]has been released!

[b]What's New:[/b]
- Made it possible to see the ball behind occluding geometry once again 
- Fixed an issue where Sticky Paste could soft lock the game (mainly in connection with Hyper Speed)
- Fixed a visual glitch where the face of the ball would sometimes separate from the body visually
- Fixed fences in Tutorial having too many holes where the ball could roll through
-⛳🐟

notes.title: Golfie v0.0.22 Hotfix 3 - fixing issues with Steam integration and leaderboards
notes.notes:
[b]Golfie v0.0.22 Hotfix 3[/b] has been released!

[b]What's New:[/b]
- Fixed an issue where the Steam integration would fail, resulting in no leaderboard submissions, and generally just breaking the game in other ways!
- Fixed an issue where Emergency Parachute could break the game

Thanks to everyone submitting bug reports on the discord!

notes.title: Golfie v0.0.15 Hotfix 3
notes.notes:
[b]What's New:[/b]
- Fixed an issue where setting volume of any slider to 0 resulted in non-muted audio
- Fixed an issue where the Settings menu closed the first time it was opened in-game
- New card art for Repulsive Field, Sellout, and Rubber Coating
- Collector perk now displays the progress towards next healing
- Wind obstacle no longer absolutely yeets the free cam
- Fixed an issue where sometimes perks didn't do their promised effect (eg. 1 additional option in crystals, etc)
- Renamed Grave Digger to Scavenger
- Corrected & adjusted various rooms

notes.title: v0.0.15 Hotfix 2
notes.notes:
[b]What's New:[/b]
- Fixed UI rendering bug where perks did not show up to the right
- Heat Sink perk no longer negates negative heat (eg. from 'Coolant' card)

notes.title: 0.0.8 Hotfix 2
notes.notes:
[b]What's New:[/b]
- Fixed bug where ball becomes infinitely small if you abandon run before the ball has spawned
- Fixed a bug where an error message would be return if requesting leaderboard data multiple times within a second

notes.title: Update Notes (August 27th, 2021) - Version 0.0.7
notes.notes:
[b]What's New:[/b]
- Players are now rewarded with a choice between 3 cards for <= 1 shot level completion (this reward is unaffected by perks)
- Players are now rewarded +X coins for completing a hole in X shots under Par
- Raised prices a slight bit in the shop
- Player now selects the theme in the start of the run and then every 6 levels (excluding themes that have already been selected before). In endless mode the theme is randomized like before)
- New card: [i]Shock Absorber[/i] - Eliminates ball bouncing
- New card: [i]Sign Flip[/i] - Reverse the balls current velocity
- New card: [i]Cheater [/i]- Next shot doesn't count in the shot counter
- New card: [i]Bullet Time [/i]- Activate (hold) to slow time to 25%
- New card: [i]Sellout [/i]- Lose 1 life, gain 10 coins
- New card: [i]Discard 1, Draw 1[/i]
- New perk: [i]Collector [/i]- Heal 1 life for every 20 coins collected (starting from acquisition)
- Added range preview to Magnetic/Repulsive Field
- Reworked Enlarge to Inflate - Effectively become a beach ball by reducing mass while increasing size, bounciness and drag
- Doubled Impact Grenade destruction radius (1m -> 2m) + fixed the sound asset
- Shop now displays through everything (even explosion particles or happy little robot balls)
- Card Pile Views (discard/draw) now randomizes the display order of the cards
- Fixed Sticky Paste death loop regression
- Leaderboard now supports 3 digit position label ('100' looked buggy before)
- Player no longer keeps the cards on hand if winning a level by using Magnetic/Repulsive Field or Teleport
- Diminished chance of ball wiggling infinitely, effectively soft-locking the game
- Player now can't lose lives after winning a level until starting a new level (eg. by exploding out of the hole and into the abyss)
- Running out of lives now immediately ends the run (instead of waiting for end of round)

notes.title: v0.0.6 Hotfix 1
notes.notes: Fixed a soft lock issue, some leaderboard things and a level design issue.

notes.title: Update Notes (August 18th, 2021) - Version 0.0.6
notes.notes:
[b]What's New:[/b]
- New theme: [i]Beach[/i]! Enjoy some time in the sun, but don't fall in the water!
- Ability to [b]win a run[/b]! Complete level 18 and you have won! You may also choose to continue playing in endless mode...
- Wins tracking! Now you can see how many runs you've won in the main menu screen!
- Added global leaderboard! Compete for the top spot! Don't use offensive names, or they will be removed!
- New perks - [i]Heal 1[/i], [i]Heal 2[/i], [i]Shop chance increase[/i]
- Now there are 3 camera modes -[i] Orbit[/i] (default), [i]Free-Look[/i], and [i]Locked[/i]. These can be switched between using the [C] key. 
It is now possible to position the camera in Free-Look mode, then lock it and shoot from there. Useful for when the ball is in awkward positions (like corners or under overhangs)!
- The shoot circle now tracks the position of the ball for a bit more intuitive behaviour!

notes.title: Update Notes (August 8th, 2021) - Version 0.0.5
notes.notes:
[b]What's New:[/b]
- Made [i]Jump[/i] card Uncommon (downgrade from Rare)
- Increased chance to get Rare cards from Blue Crystals
- The level generator should now not pick the same spawn or flag room 2 levels in a row
- Free Cam button prompts now also shows in Location Selection mode (magnetic fields/teleport)
- Fixed physics properties on coins (they were way too light and spazzy when affected by physics fields)
- Fixed issue where you sometimes drew too many cards in the beginning of a round
- Added a helpful tooltip about toggling free cam the very first round a player has

notes.title: Update Notes (August 6th, 2021) - Version 0.0.4
notes.notes:
[b]What's New:[/b]
- Added a couple of new rooms in both Floating Islands and Dungeon themes
- Fixed weird text glitch with cards/perks in crystals
- Fixed horrible sound loop bug with Sticky Paste
- Added Triheart Studio logo in Main Menu

notes.title: Update Notes (August 5th, 2021) - Version 0.0.3
notes.notes:
[b]What's New:[/b]
- New Loading Screen!
- Fixed a bunch of UI stuff.
- Added a bunch of new sounds!
- New card: [i]Shrink [/i]- Shrink the ball to half current size until the end of the round.
- New card: [i]Enlarge [/i]- Enlarge the ball to double its current size until the end of the round.
- New card: [i]Hyper Speed[/i] - Add [b]a lot[/b] of power to the shot!
- New spawn VFX! (+ fixed the spawn death loop issue)
- Added an *End Turn* button to spend a shot and end the turn without shooting the ball.
- Settings are now remembered across sessions!
- Fixed the Sticky Paste death loop issue (If you died with Sticky Paste active, you respawn with Sticky Paste active)
- Fixed an issue where the game would soft lock if you didn't have enough cards on hand to discard.
- Fixed "ghost card" issue where discarding and drawing the same card quickly in succession could lead to an invisible & unplayable card on hand.
- Removed ability to open settings behind win/lose popups.
- Removed ability to open the debug menu in release builds.
- Fixed an issue where crates and coins would fall through the level while it is being generated.

notes.title: Update Notes (July 30th, 2021) - Version 0.0.2
notes.notes:
[b]What's New:[/b]
[olist]
[*] Added rocks around the perimiters on a lot of floating islands
[*] Added quick coin pickup sound, because it's a damn crime to not have one.
[/olist]

notes.title: Update Notes (July 29th, 2021) - Version 0.0.1
notes.notes:
From now on all updates happens through Steam, and this also marks the end of the "Demo X" labeling, starting with this version (0.0.1).

Hope you will enjoy the game, and don't forget to join the [url=https://discord.gg/4CRYf4yMzg]Discord server[/url] for feedback and suggestions!

Cheers 💚
